title: Deployments Software Engineer
summary: Integrate robot models with field systems; optimize real-time compute, memory, I/O, networking, and teleoperation reliability.
fit: Whole-system optimization transfers to a genuinely new physical-world domain.
stretch: Robot integration, video streaming, teleoperation, and real-time production systems.
watchFor: This is broader deployment and teleoperation work, not exclusively onboard inference. Confirm the proportion of ML runtime ownership.

title: Software Engineer, Onboard Platform
summary: Build the onboard platform for autonomous equipment, including runtime services and CPU/GPU/memory performance for real-time workloads.
fit: Direct hardware/software overlap with a new autonomy and field-deployment problem space.
stretch: Embedded Linux, robot middleware, sensor bring-up, and fleet reliability.
watchFor: The role also includes OS services, updates, and platform maintenance. Confirm meaningful performance ownership and level expectations.

title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Performance
summary: Improve language and diffusion model throughput and latency across open-source inference systems and the container runtime.
fit: A strong bridge from GPU architecture and workload efficiency into hands-on inference software.
stretch: Production inference engines, CUDA execution details, and runtime implementation.
watchFor: Requires demonstrated high-performance coding, GPU performance work, and familiarity with CUDA and vLLM or TensorRT. Work arrangement needs confirmation.

title: Software Engineer - Model Performance
location: San Francisco / Toronto / New York / Montreal
summary: Take inference optimizations such as quantization, speculative decoding, and KV caching from experiments into production.
fit: Combines deep GPU understanding with ownership of measurable, model-level performance improvements.
stretch: LLM serving techniques and hands-on work inside TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, SGLang, and PyTorch.
watchFor: LLM optimization familiarity is expected. Confirm room to ramp and the team's decision speed at this later-stage company.

title: Inference Software Engineer
summary: Port models to custom accelerators and build multi-node inference, execution state, communication, and runtime error handling.
fit: A software-forward move that still rewards accelerator architecture and hardware-aware reasoning.
stretch: C++ or Rust runtime development, collectives, and model porting to non-standard hardware.
watchFor: Check the expected existing model-porting experience and how much work is runtime design versus integration.

title: Performance Modeling Engineer
summary: Model accelerator performance, characterize ML bottlenecks, validate against silicon, and influence next-generation architecture.
fit: The most direct architecture-aligned transfer while expanding into accelerator hardware/software co-design.
stretch: Custom accelerator modeling, multi-chip inference, and architecture exploration.
watchFor: Ensure the role influences implementation and architecture rather than being mostly benchmark reporting or familiar power work.

summary: Build AI-driven experiment loops that turn models and profiler feedback into verified accelerator kernels and mappings.

stretch: Kernel engineering, agent-driven optimization, and correctness/performance evaluation infrastructure.
watchFor: Requires actual kernel tuning experience. Treat as a stretch until that requirement is calibrated; posted cash range may also matter.

title: Member of Technical Staff - Systems
summary: Build and maintain high-performance distributed systems behind a serverless compute platform.
fit: A possible route into resource management at a new scale, with a strong systems-performance foundation.
stretch: Large-scale distributed services, Linux internals, cloud infrastructure, and production on-call.
